name: Mosaic Production Card
describe: Production dashboard tile: empty 40px --ac-t tile, unit name, three stat tiles in Geist Mono, "Click to view KOTs" footer.

Production dashboard grid; one per production unit; click opens that unit's KOT board. "Main Kitchen" Arabic name is sample data. Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic/src/index.css defines one light palette (:root only) and no dark: classes or .dark overrides, so the KDS has no dark theme).
